about: Package 3c's accepted differences between the concept's page and the rebuild's in its states (slice-states/32-instruments-3c.mjs), each with its reason and its exact count (vb.mjs compare --accept). A difference these do not cover fails the comparison; so does a count that changes.

accepted.why: Deviation 11 (slice-accepted.json): every button and input carries its type.
Deviation 10: a choice's button carries its value ("new", "off"), the concept's its words.
Deviation 6: a segmented choice is a named group (Section mode, Lyric timing, Renderer, Curve).
Deviation P3c-5 (E-46): Play kept stands before Render in the build's foot, so the foot's buttons after Re-plan are one place on from the concept's.
The board's Follow score and Plan strength are labelled pairings (package 2's labelled): their tip is on the pairing and joins the token's own, where the concept put it on the caps label.

The lead sheet's paper carries its parameter's data-ctl (package 1's textArea, the changed mark's hook) and is named by the parameter's label, "Lead sheet (ABC)"; the concept wrote "Lead sheet in ABC" by hand.
Deviation 26: a drop zone names its file field by its state's noun ("Choose the recording").
Package 2's drop zone gives the file's name as the tip of its bold name, so a long name cut short can be read whole.
Deviation P3c-5 (E-47): the play button for the chosen part, at the end of its caption line.
Deviation 10: the strip's buttons run their own actions (the slice's Tile), without the concept's delegation hooks.
MiniMax-Music3's renderer offers Auto, the server's own choice, before GGML and TensorRT (docs/03, "Things the definitions handle differently"): the buttons are one place on from the concept's.
The same: the third renderer button (TensorRT) has no counterpart among the concept's two.
Deviation 10 (the concept's [data-adg]/[data-adpow] hooks) and deviation 15 (a power chip names its parameter and carries data-ctl and data-power), as containers-accepted.json counts them.
Deviation 15: the record buttons name their parameter ("Save the next Plank"), the concept's say "● SAVE NEXT".
The LED switch's tip is package 3b's (the slice's ledButton carries none yet); package 2 counts the same (containers-accepted.json).
The LCD picker's arrows (.cyc) in standards mode (styles/rebuild/10-standards.css, the slice's).
Deviation 6: a knob says its value to a screen reader.

Standards mode (styles/rebuild/25-instruments-3c.css, as the slice's 10-standards.css): the lead sheet's paper, the preview's seed line and the Experimental badge's line are blocks, so each is as tall as the concept's quirks-mode page draws it (measured: the same tops and heights).
